/.description: Choose a partner, compare attacks and items, plan Lab spending or read a guide before your next run. Check seasonal challenges, dated standings and patch notes when you return.

/play.description: Open the free browser game, check the controls and choose your first partner. Keep these guides nearby when an upgrade or unlock needs explaining.

/pokedex.h1: PokeBonk Pokédex - Compare Partners, Kits & Unlocks
/pokedex.description: Browse 151 Pokémon and filter the 79 League partners. Select a portrait to check its stats, attacks, passive, evolution path and unlock condition.

/wiki/items.h1: PokeBonk Wiki - Compare Item Effects & Unlocks
/wiki/items.description: Compare item effects, rarities and held limits. Filter the starting pool or Lab unlocks, then check the price before spending Stardust.

/wiki/achievements.h1: PokeBonk Achievements - Find Your Next Unlock
/wiki/achievements.description: Find a goal worth working toward. Check its exact condition, Stardust reward or Mastery Look, then keep a personal checklist in this browser.

/wiki/lab.h1: PokeBonk Lab - Plan Your Next Stardust Purchase
/wiki/lab.description: Compare permanent upgrades, preview the next level’s price and calculate the cost of several levels. Check item unlocks before deciding what to buy.

/tier-list.h1: PokeBonk Tier List - Compare Partners & Build Your Ranking
/tier-list.description: Rank all 151 Pokémon on your own board, or read why we place each of the 79 starting kits where we do for a solo Classic opening.

/builds.h1: PokeBonk Builds - Survival Combinations We Tested
/builds.description: From our Survival testing, these are the partner combinations that made a run easier to keep going. Each one names the attack to keep, the level-8 fusion, three vitamins and the items to take first.

/guides.description: Pick the guide for the run you want to improve: your first Classic clear, PokéBonk Survival or PokéBonk Co-op. Follow the choices, examples and tradeoffs inside.

/wiki/leaderboard.description: Browse the complete Season 2 Global top 100 for KOs, Survival and Time attack, recorded on October 28, 2026. Compare regional scores, player appearances and projected rewards.

/updates.description: Search published patch notes through v0.8.62. Find the balance changes, fixes and new features that affect your next run, with each release dated.

/about.description: pokebonkdb.org is a planning site for PokéBonk. This page explains what you can look up here, and what the game itself asks you to do in a run.

/privacy-policy.description: How this site handles browser storage, technical requests and information you choose to send by email.

/terms.description: The terms that apply when you browse pokebonkdb.org or use its local planning tools.

/copyright.description: An explanation of the site’s original content, third-party game material and independent fan-site status.

/contact.description: Send a site question, content correction or artwork concern to support@pokebonkdb.org. This mailbox supports the fan site, not game accounts.

/events.h1: PokeBonk Events - Check Challenges, Dates & Rewards
/events.description: Check the four daily modes and their permanent rewards, then browse seasonal challenges, event dates and Candle milestones. Each event is labeled by its schedule.

/wiki/attacks.h1: PokeBonk Wiki - Compare Attacks & Find Fusions
/wiki/attacks.description: Find an attack by name, type, damage class or shape. Compare its effects, level growth and learners, or check the ingredients before committing to a fusion.

/wiki/vitamins.h1: PokeBonk Wiki - Choose Vitamins for Your Build
/wiki/vitamins.description: Compare what each vitamin improves, how its gains grow and what rarer cards add. Save a three-slot plan for a partner in this browser.
